views.name: lineup
views.title: Choose your lifeboat
views.caption: five lifeboats, one in each colour; how good the others are; go

views.name: racing
views.title: Out on the coast
views.caption: riding behind your boat; the stick in its corner, the places along the top, how far to go down the side

views.name: line
views.title: The line goes over
views.caption: alongside and slowed right down: the crew throws a line to the little boat

views.name: climb
views.title: Climbing aboard
views.caption: pulled in against the hull, they climb up the side one at a time

views.name: deck
views.title: A full deck
views.caption: the rescued fill the aft deck, then the foredeck, the side decks and the roof

views.name: finish
views.title: The harbour mouth
views.caption: the finish: through the gap between the lighthouses, under the banner

views.name: podium
views.title: 1st to 5th
views.caption: in at the quay, the places by most rescued

views.name: wide
views.title: On a bigger screen
views.caption: granite cliffs, a cobalt sea laced with foam, the wake churning white

views.name: study
views.title: The lifeboat
views.caption: navy hull, red below the waterline, RNLI along the bow; the wheelhouse in the boat’s own colour, a tall black mast; the crew in white helmets

views.name: weather-calm
views.title: Calm
views.caption: a gentle swell, little foam, gulls

views.name: weather-windy
views.title: Windy
views.caption: a bigger, steeper sea; whitecaps and streaks of foam; spray flying

views.name: weather-stormy
views.title: Stormy
views.caption: a big grey sea under a lid of cloud; rain, lightning, the beams already turning

views.name: weather-foggy
views.title: Foggy
views.caption: the coast lost in it; the lighthouses’ beams and the searchlight cut through

views.name: weather-night
views.title: Night
views.caption: stars, the moon on the water, windows lit, the beams turning, your searchlight ahead

views.name: weather-sunset
views.title: Sunset
views.caption: the sun low ahead, the sea gold and the cliffs warm

views.name: storm-wide
views.title: A storm, on a bigger screen
views.caption: the swell high enough to hide the next boat

views.name: night-wide
views.title: Night, on a bigger screen
views.caption: your searchlight on the water, the lighthouse beam sweeping the harbour mouth
